name: @luccet/wiki
description: A wiki for Luccet notes: a list of a folder's notes, a search box over them and a glossary of the terms they define, from what luccet index writes.

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:node: node test/notes/node.js && node test/search/node.js && node test/glossary/node.js
scripts.test:browser: node test/notes/browser.js && node test/search/browser.js && node test/glossary/browser.js
